  Analysis of IELTS Exam Results data from TidyTuesday

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
performance_by_first_language <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-08-18/performance_by_first_language.csv')
view(performance_by_first_language)
```


```{r}
overall <- performance_by_first_language |> 
    filter(part == "overall") |> 
    group_by(language)
```
